constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards, plans under 400 lines, Python files under 1000 lines.

Example configs use placeholders and secret references only; no committed secrets.
Conventions 7a: fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands; build outputs to /tmp.

designDecisionsAndRationale: p28 split into p28-assembly, p28b-e2e-flows and p28c-leak-matrix with disjoint writePaths so the oversized assembly dispatch fits fanout limits (architecture.md section 8 Run B2).

Assembly bindings (design-collectors-and-ingestion.md): per-config collector selection and missing-credential errors are lazy; webhook secrets unset fail closed with 401; one HMAC-derived Drive channel key shared by watch creation and verification.

Leak matrix traces sink (design-masking.md): install_excepthook(redactor) with monkeypatch restore; log_buffer is the traceback sink with an 'Uncaught exception' non-empty guard; capsys stderr is an extra must-be-clean sink.
Waves B2-1 {p13, p28-assembly}, B2-2 {p28b, p28c}, B2-3 {p29}: acyclic, file-disjoint; p29 last because it runs whole-repository gates.
intentionalTradeoffs: Explicitly set global credential refs (TELESCREEN_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, TELESCREEN_GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT) resolve at build time and exit 3 when broken (fail-fast), diverging from lazy resolution in 'Assembly bindings'; accepted as low residual by step5.
Screenshot smoke or docker compose config may be unavailable locally; recorded as verification gaps per design-ui-sentry.md 8.5.
supportedEdgeCases: Unset webhook secrets -> 401; unresolvable secret ref -> ConfigError exit 3.
Sweep partial without removal reconciliation; concurrent sweep start -> 409.
Evidence with raw value rejected then clean evidence accepted; police send-back then pass.
Scanner unavailable -> 503; image metadata stripped; raw pushed findings rejected.
Active file:/run/secrets/<name> refs in .env.example map to compose secrets.<name> (tests/examples).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real PostgreSQL/Meilisearch/Slack/Google/GitHub network behavior (fakes and MockTransport only).
OIDC SSO (deferred; bearer API tokens in v1).

designChangeThisRun: architecture.md section 8 Run B2 paragraph (split and waves); design-collectors-and-ingestion.md 'Assembly bindings (telescreen.wiring, run B2)'; design-masking.md leak matrix traces sink and harness seams. Accepted by step3-design-review comm-005786 (needs_revision=false).
waveRationale: p13 edits only two web page directories and p28-assembly only Python assembly files, so they run in parallel. p28b and p28c need the collector registry and webhook secrets bound by p28-assembly; they own disjoint test files (tests/e2e/harness.py plus tests/e2e/test_flow_*.py vs tests/leak) and do not import each other. p29 runs alone last because it runs the final whole-repository and web gates over everything.
